The Senior Analytics Consultant is a senior individual contributor who serves as a strategic analytics partner to business leaders. This role transforms complex pharmacy, sales, and operational data into actionable insights that inform decisions, improve performance, and drive business outcomes. Sitting at the intersection of business strategy, analytics, and technology, the Senior Analytics Consultant translates ambiguous business questions into analytical approaches, delivers decision-support solutions, and communicates the story behind the data to technical and non-technical audiences.

Use your skills to make an impact

Key Responsibilities

• Lead complex analytical initiatives that support strategic business priorities and operational performance.

• Serve as a consultative analytics partner to business leaders, helping define problems, identify opportunities, formulate hypotheses, and develop data-driven recommendations.

• Independently lead analytics engagements from intake and discovery through analysis, solution development, stakeholder alignment, and delivery of business outcomes.

• Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and key performance drivers.

• Design and develop meaningful metrics, frameworks, dashboards, and decision-support tools.

• Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations tailored to executive, operational, and technical audiences.

• Influence strategic decisions by providing insights that impact growth, profitability, customer outcomes, and operational efficiency.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of analytics experience or Master's degree and 3+ years of analytics experience.

• Demonstrated ability to serve as a consultative analytics partner, working directly with business stakeholders to define problems, evaluate opportunities, and deliver actionable recommendations.

• Experience leading projects through the full analytics lifecycle, including business intake, discovery, analysis, solution development, communication of insights, and implementation support.

• Progressive experience in analytics, business intelligence, informatics, pharmacy analytics, sales analytics, or a related field.

• Strong proficiency with SQL, reporting and visualization tools, and analytical methodologies.

• Experience communicating insights and recommendations to senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

• Advanced degree in Informatics, Analytics, Business Analytics, Healthcare Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field.

• Experience working with pharmacy, payer, provider, sales, or operational data.

• Demonstrated intellectual curiosity and continuous learning with the ability to rapidly learn new business domains and analytical approaches.

• Experience using SQL, Power BI, Databricks, Python, or similar tools to support business decision-making.

This role is best suited for candidates who are energized by consultative analytics, business problem solving, and decision support. While the role requires strong SQL skills to query, analyze, and work with large datasets, the primary focus is not pipeline development, infrastructure engineering, or software development.

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Anvil, Altius, Ghost, and other developmental UAS platforms are built to operate in remote environments with limited user input, driving requirements for reliability and autonomy. We have developed an autonomy stack that receives user intent, responds to detections processed at the edge, and coordinates flight patterns for groups of assets. We are looking for systems engineers with experience in this field to help design and manage the next generation of Anduril’s flight vehicles. In order to be successful at Anduril, a systems engineer needs to be familiar with simulation and rapid prototyping development to drive complex electro-mechanical and aero-performance design trades, in addition to supporting the engineering product development, production, and sustainment through the entire product lifecycle.

• Collaborate with the team to define and document software engineering processes and practices, ensuring adherence to quality standards and regulatory requirements

• 12+ years of post-grad industry experience, including but not limited to electrical engineering, aerospace engineering, or systems engineering

• A passion for systems design development, integration, and test

• Hands-on prototyping, troubleshooting, and build experience

• Experience Developing automated test scrips and frameworks using a common language (eg. Python, MATLAB, etc)

• Extremely organized and detail-oriented

• Excellent verbal & written communication skills

• A sincere commitment to a positive, inclusive, and collaborative culture

• Must hold a U.S. Secret security clearance, or higher

• Ability to travel up to 25% as needed for test planning and execution

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Hands on experience with complex robotic systems

• Familiarity with IP-Based networks

• Experience with mission systems, including communications systems and components

• Familiarity with aviation airworthiness considerations

title: Scientist R&D
description:
Scientist R&D

We are seeking an innovative Scientist to join Natera's Platform Technologies team within the Research & Development organization. In this impactful role, you will conduct pre-product research to develop and advance cutting-edge NGS technologies and expand Natera's growing technology portfolio by planning, designing, and executing laboratory research. Additionally, you will investigate the feasibility of applying a wide variety of scientific principles and concepts to potential products and problems, based on your broad knowledge of state-of-the-art principles and theories. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in molecular biology, demonstrated experience in developing Next Generation Sequencing (NGS) technologies, and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

 

Primary Responsibilities:

• Contributes substantially and intellectually to research and development

• Leads research projects to design and demonstrate the feasibility of novel nucleic acid based diagnostic methods

• Independently develops plans, generates ideas, and advances research objectives with minimal oversight

• Plans and executes complex laboratory experiments, analyzes data, and applies insights to guide and refine project direction

• Defines project plans with stakeholder input and coordinates efforts to achieve milestones within established timelines

• Coordinates the execution and analysis of effective experiments with statistics and bioinformatics teams

• Proposes, investigates, and implements innovative solutions to advance research objectives and overcome technical challenges

• Communicates progress directly with colleagues and senior management, providing regular updates on project outcomes and next steps

 

Minimum Qualifications:

• Ph.D. or equivalent in molecular biology, genomics, or a closely related discipline

• Minimum 2 years of industry experience post-Ph.D., or at least 1 year of industry experience following the completion of postdoctoral research

• Hands-on experience with Next Generation Sequencing (NGS) technologies and sample preparation methods, including DNA/RNA extraction, library preparation, target enrichment (e.g., multiplex PCR, hybrid capture), and DNA sequencers

• Experience conceptualizing, prototyping, and advancing NGS technologies from initial concept to product development

• Strong research skills with a track record of designing and implementing innovative and scalable solutions

• Demonstrated ability to exercise independent scientific judgment in experimental design and analysis

• Proficient in data analysis and statistical testing using tools such as Excel, JMP, R, or Python

• Proven success in partnering with bioinformatics and data science teams to drive project advancement

• Demonstrated ability to write clear project plans, study protocols, and standard operating procedures

 

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience working within a CLIA lab environment or under a Quality Management System

• Experience with epigenetics/methylation, cfDNA/RNA, or digital PCR technologies

• Bioinformatics capabilities or programming experience (e.g., Python, R, SQL)

title: Growth Product Manager
description:
About Fyxer
Since launching in May 2024 we've grown to $30 million in ARR. Fyxer is building an AI executive assistant that handles emails, scheduling and follow-up, freeing people in client-facing roles to focus on their customers.
The Mission
At Fyxer, we believe the only sustainable competitive advantage for a startup is the quality and speed of execution .
We are looking for a full-stack product thinker who uses research, data, and experimentation to drive better bets, faster learning, and stronger commercial outcomes. We’re not looking for someone to write specs and hand over insights. We want someone who helps us think better and decide better.
You’ll drive product vision and strategy of a product domain alongside our product, growth and leadership teams.

The Role
You’ll drive product vision and strategy of a product domain / category design alongside our product / growth and leadership teams.
You will operate at speed. We care about generating signals quickly, making informed decisions, and learning fast. You are comfortable working with imperfect information and tightening thinking as you go.
You will have significant autonomy. We expect strong judgment, clear communication, and ownership of outcomes and a fullstack background around A/B experimentation and everything that comes with it.
What you will own:
You will own the quality of our product bets and the speed at which we learn.

• Turn ambiguity into direction. Take messy signals from customers, product data, and the market and translate them into clear problem framing and product strategy.

• Work directly with engineers. You will partner closely with engineers and founders from the start of an initiative, shaping solutions together rather than handing over specs.

• Use the right tools to validate ideas and reduce risk: interviews, prototypes, experiments, product analytics, fake doors, usability testing, and behavioural analysis

• Ship, learn, and iterate quickly. Move product bets from idea to shipped product to measurable outcomes, continuously tightening the loop between learning and building.

• Raise the bar of product thinking across the team by coaching others, introducing scalable frameworks, and helping the team stay close to customers

Who You Are

• Expert: You are an expert in your domain specialization that everyone could learn from including our other PM’s

• Systems thinker: You understand customer journeys, funnels, and feedback loops. You connect user behaviour to outcomes and revenue impact, not just isolated features.

• Engineering partner : You work closely with engineers and founders, translating user insight into clear problem framing and practical tradeoffs. You influence what we build through evidence and clarity.

• Decision oriented : You know when there is enough signal to move. You help others clarify thinking, sharpen hypotheses, and make confident calls under uncertainty.

• Capability builder: You design product systems that compound over time rather than one off projects. Your work levels up how we do product and discovery across the company, and you introduce frameworks, coach others, and build repeatable learning loops.

Why Fyxer?
We are intentional about our team. We believe a small, exceptional team working with extreme focus will always outperform a large, bloated organization.

• Autonomy: We hire people who want ownership and then we actually give it to them.

• Scope: This is a rare opportunity to join a high-growth rocket ship at the foundational stage..

• Velocity: You will be fast-tracked into senior responsibilities far earlier than at a traditional company.

Compensation Range: £140K - £180K

title: Sotftware Tester (QA) - InteleShare
description:
As a Software Tester on the InteleShare team, you'll safeguard the quality of the platform that healthcare providers use to share and exchange medical imaging. Working across the full testing lifecycle, you'll partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to catch issues before they reach customers, strengthen our automation practices, and help ensure every release meets the reliability our industry demands.
The work is automation-first. InteleShare is covered by a BDD test framework written in Java 17 and Maven - Cucumber feature files driving Selenium page objects for the web UI and Rest-Assured clients for the APIs, with Allure and ExtentReports for results and Jira Xray for test management - executed against nine application components and nine environments through GitHub Actions. You will write and own tests in that framework, not just execute them manually.
Key Responsibilities

• Test Planning & Execution: Participate in the full testing lifecycle - requirements validation, test planning, and test case development - through functional, regression, performance, and user acceptance testing, covering image sharing and exchange workflows end to end: DICOM ingestion and retrieval, HL7-driven order and report flows, storage backends, viewer behaviour, and the web application.

• Automation & Process Improvement: Write and maintain automated tests in the InteleShare framework - Gherkin feature files, Java step definitions, Selenium page objects, and Rest-Assured API tests - and improve the framework's reliability, coverage, and testability within an Agile Scrum environment.

• CI & Test Operations: Run and triage regression suites through GitHub Actions across components, environments, browsers, and operating systems; keep results flowing into Jira Xray with useful evidence; and drive down flaky tests so failures mean something.

• Defect Management: Identify, document, and report defects with clear reproduction steps, logs, and evidence, maintaining traceability in Jira/Xray from business requirements and technical specifications through test cases and executions to resolution.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to formulate test scenarios, reproduce customer escalations, troubleshoot issues across the stack, and support post-release and post-implementation testing.

• Stakeholder Engagement: Interact with clients and internal stakeholders to understand product requirements and translate them into effective test coverage.

Qualifications & Experience

• Up-to-date knowledge of software test design and testing methodologies

• 2+ years of experience as a Software Tester or QA Analyst on web applications, including hands-on test automation, or equivalent experience.

• Experience with project management principles and QA methodology

• Working knowledge of test management tooling (Jira with Xray, or equivalents such as qTest or Zephyr) and of SQL for verifying data directly in the database (PostgreSQL).

• Enough programming ability to write and maintain automated tests in an object-oriented language - Java preferred, since the InteleShare framework is Java/Maven - and comfort working in Git/GitHub with pull request reviews.

• Ability to investigate a failure below the UI: reading application logs, inspecting REST/JSON requests and responses, and using browser developer tools.

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment with minimal supervision

Preferred Qualifications & Special Requirements

• Familiarity with Agile frameworks and regression testing

• Hands-on experience with Selenium and a BDD framework (Cucumber/Gherkin), and with API test automation (Rest-Assured, Postman, or similar).

• Experience running automated suites in CI (GitHub Actions or equivalent) and working with test reporting tools such as Allure or ExtentReports.

title: 2027 Summer Intern, PhD, Safety Research, Human Behavior Analytics
description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver-The World's Most Experienced Driver™-to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The Human Behavior Analytics (HBA) team, part of the Waymo Safety team, conducts research and development on computational road user behavior models and other methods and tools used for evaluating the behavior and safety of the Waymo Driver. This work typically exists at the intersection between AI/ML and cognitive science and is done in close collaboration with other Waymo teams, in particular SW Research, Systems Engineering, Simulation and Data Science. The HBA team also engages extensively in research with external academic partners.

Waymo interns partner with leaders in the industry on projects that create impact to the company. We believe learning is a two-way street: applying your knowledge while providing you with opportunities to expand your skill-set. Interns are an important part of our culture and our recruiting pipeline. Join us at Waymo for a fun and rewarding internship!

 

You will:

• Survey the state-of-the-art in digital neuroscience / cognitive science and mechanistic interpretability

• Develop models able to represent some select aspects of human driving behavior not typically accounted for by existing data-driven ML models (e.g., collision avoidance, road user interaction or visual behavior)

• Explore and demonstrate different ways in which the internal mechanisms of these models can be interpreted and explained

 

You have:

• A strong research background and expertise in cognitive science and / or neuroscience

• Expertise in contemporary AI and machine learning

• Strong documented computational skills (math and coding)

title: Director, EMEA Government Affairs & Public Policy
description:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk. 

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role in a nutshell:

Our customers include some of the most regulated organizations in the world, and we have a strong and growing UK and European customer base. Europe is one of our highest-growth priorities.

It is also where the rules for our category are actively being written - the Cyber Resilience Act, NIS2, the EU AI Act, and the standards work running underneath all of them.

We are hiring our first dedicated European government affairs and public policy leader to own that ground. You will set Chainguard’s European policy strategy, establish us as a trusted technical voice with the officials and bodies shaping cyber regulation on the continent and in the UK, and translate fast-moving policy into what it means for our positioning, our product, and our customers.

What you'll do

• Set and own Chainguard’s European policy strategy - priorities, positions, target institutions and officials, and the narrative we take into the policy process.

• Engage governments, regulators, and standards bodies across Europe and the UK, including the European Commission (notably DG CNECT and DG GROW), the European Parliament, ENISA, and the standards bodies - CEN-CENELEC and ETSI - doing the technical work underneath the CRA and NIS2.

• Decide where Chainguard shows up through industry coalitions (e.g., DigitalEurope, CCIA Europe, BSA, techUK) versus direct advocacy, and represent Chainguard in those bodies where it adds leverage.

• Forecast what’s coming, not just what’s happened, bringing political acumen and the ability to read where a debate is heading before it becomes public on developments relevant to Chainguard.

• Develop policy positions, consultation responses, and written submissions, and speak authoritatively on Chainguard’s behalf in public and industry fora.

• Translate technical concepts into policy language - and emerging requirements back into clear implications for our messaging and roadmap.

• Support product, marketing, and revenue teams with policy credibility and positioning where it helps them, while staying firmly on the policy side of the line.

• Build the function by establishing the processes, relationships, and intelligence flow that make European government affairs repeatable rather than a series of one-offs.

• As the business grows in the region, help build the path toward leading a team.

Who you are:

• 8+ years of directly relevant experience in government affairs or public policy - within a public sector organization, a regulatory or standard-setting body, or a private company with a comparable government affairs function

• A track record of building independently: standing up or growing a government affairs program or line of effort, or developing and shepherding specific regulations, standards, or policy strategy through to an outcome

• Senior official engagement experience, with the judgment and presence to represent a company credibly at that level

• Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical subject matter for policy audiences - and to explain how you do it

• Comfort operating in ambiguity with minimal guidance, and a scrappy, resourceful approach to reach and impact

• Excellent written and verbal communication; credible with executives, engineers, and government stakeholders alike

• A degree and/or equivalent years of experience in the field

• Based in Europe

title: Construction Scheduler - Memphis
description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge.  Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Develop, maintain, and communicate construction schedules that the field, subcontractors, and leadership can actually use. You will build CPM baselines, update them from real progress, flag risk early, and explain schedule impact of changes, delays, and recovery plans. This is not a data-entry role. You need enough means-and-methods knowledge to challenge a sequence that will not work in the field.

Superintendents run the work; project managers own cost and contracts; the scheduler is the person who can tell you what is actually driving the end date, what slips if a trade is late, and whether a recovery plan is real.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Build baseline CPM schedules from drawings, specs, estimates, bid packages, and construction sequences (WBS, activity coding, logic, calendars, and constraints used sparingly and correctly).

• Maintain the live schedule: collect progress from superintendents, project managers, and trades; update percent complete, remaining duration, and logic; publish a clean current-period update on a set cadence (typically weekly look-aheads and monthly official updates).

• Own the critical path. Identify near-critical work, float erosion, and out-of-sequence progress. Tell the team why the end date moved, not just that it did.

• Produce three-week (or similar) look-aheads that match the master schedule and what the field can actually crew.

• Analyze schedule impact of RFIs, change orders, design late-outs, access constraints, long-lead procurement, weather, and labor shortages. Prepare time-impact analyses (TIA) and what-if, recovery, and acceleration scenarios.

• Coordinate with project managers, superintendents, estimators, procurement, design, owners/CMs, and subcontractors so the schedule reflects committed dates, not wishful ones.

• Resource-load and, where required, cost-load the schedule. Flag crew stacking, craft shortages, and unrealistic production rates.

• Prepare narratives, variance reports, S-curves, histograms, and executive summaries for internal reviews and owner/CM submittals.

• Support claims and delay documentation with contemporaneous records (as-planned vs. as-built, fragnets, delay categorization) when needed.

• Enforce schedule standards: naming, coding, update process, backup, and version control so the file remains auditable.

• Facilitate or support pull-planning / Last Planner sessions and convert those commitments into logic in the CPM model.

• Visit the site regularly. A scheduler who never walks the job will be wrong.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• 4+ years of construction scheduling on active projects (GC, CM, owner’s project controls, or specialty contractor).

• 4+ years of experience using Oracle Primavera P6 and comfortability with multiple calendars, relationship types, filters, layouts, global vs. project data, and schedule quality checks (open ends, negative float, SS/FF overuse, constraints). 

• 4+years of experience with owner/CM specification-driven schedules (e.g., DCMA 14-point, USACE, or similar quality metrics).

• PSP (AACE), PMI-SP, PMP, CCM, or

description:
Overview
Since 1972, Covenant House has served and advocated for youth and young families experiencing homelessness, human trafficking, and exploitation. Our overarching goal is to end homelessness among youth and young families by helping them achieve housing stability, heal from trauma, tap into their innate resilience, and hone their interests and skills to forge new pathways to independence. This work is carried out across Covenant House sites in 34 cities in the US, Canada, Mexico, Guatemala, and Honduras.
About the Role
The Senior Vice President, Corporate Partnerships is a strategic and entrepreneurial revenue leader responsible for developing and executing Covenant House International 's corporate partnership strategy. Reporting to the Chief Philanthropy Officer, the SVP will lead a high-performing team responsible for retaining, growing, and stewarding an existing portfolio of corporate partners while securing significant new corporate relationships across a diverse range of partnership types.
The SVP will drive revenue growth through philanthropic grants, corporate sponsorships, employee giving and engagement programs, cause marketing campaigns, point-of-sale and customer fundraising initiatives, licensing arrangements, and other innovative partnership models. This leader will possess deep experience across the full spectrum of nonprofit-corporate partnerships and demonstrate the ability to identify emerging trends and create new pathways for sustainable revenue generation.
As a senior leader within the organization, the SVP will help shape revenue strategy, foster a culture of collaboration and accountability, and serve as an ambassador for Covenant House's mission and values. The position requires an exceptional people leader capable of developing and empowering teams responsible for new business development, recurring partnerships, fulfillment of partner benefits, corporate employee engagement, and strategic relationship management.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Corporate Partnership Strategy and Revenue Growth

• Develop and execute a comprehensive corporate partnerships strategy that advances Covenant House International 's revenue goals and supports long-term organizational growth

• Maintain and grow a portfolio of high-value corporate partners while personally managing relationships with key executives and strategic accounts

• Lead efforts to secure new corporate partnerships through grants, sponsorships, employee engagement programs, cause marketing initiatives, customer fundraising campaigns, event sponsorships, licensing opportunities, and other revenue-generating partnerships

• Identify, evaluate, and implement innovative partnership models that create both philanthropic and earned revenue opportunities

• Establish revenue goals, performance metrics, and growth strategies for all corporate partnership channels

• Monitor market trends and corporate social impact priorities to identify new partnership opportunities and competitive advantages

Relationship Management and Partnership Development

• Build and maintain relationships with senior corporate executives, corporate foundation leaders, marketing leaders, human resources leaders, corporate social responsibility teams, and other key decision-makers

• Develop customized partnership strategies that align corporate objectives with Covenant House's mission, programs, and impact

• Oversee the successful stewardship, renewal, and expansion of existing partnerships to maximize long-term value and retention

• Collaborate with major gifts colleagues to coordinate engagement strategies for corporate executives who are also current or prospective individual donors

Leadership and Team Management

• Lead, mentor, and develop a team responsible for new business development, account management, stewardship, benefit fulfillment, employee engagement

title: Senior Systems Software Engineer - NV Cloud Functions
description:
Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIA N, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. NVIDIA Cloud Functions (NVCF) is an open-source platform that links workloads to GPUs. It lets teams deploy, manage, and serve GPU-accelerated, containerized applications across regions and clusters worldwide. The platform routes inference, streaming, and batch jobs across decentralized GPU clusters. This allows endpoints to scale repeatably, whether hosted on-prem or in the cloud.
We are seeking a Senior Systems Software Engineer to join our team. You will focus on improving the performance, reliability, and scaling behavior of a system that routes AI workloads onto distributed GPU fleets. You will work on a polyglot platform that is now fully open source, with both control plane and edge deployments. The work suits someone with deep experience in systems performance, distributed systems, and Kubernetes-based runtimes. We are looking for engineers who want to learn and grow. Expect to be challenged in an environment with rapidly shifting priorities, where insight, focus, and execution are key.
What you will be doing:

• You'll be working in a distributed team that explores innovative ways to make GPU- and DPU-accelerated applications easier to develop, deploy, and monitor on the latest and greatest NVIDIA hardware.

• Design and ship services in Java, Go, and Rust, building in the open on a public repository where your commits, design proposals, and reviews are transparent to the community.

• Work on automating and optimizing build, test, integration, and release processes for cloud native.

• Partner with engineering teams across NVIDIA so the platform integrates with adjacent NVIDIA technologies, including the KAI Scheduler, NVIDIA NIM, Grove, and Dynamo.

• Help steward an open-source project. You will triage community issues and pull requests and write docs contributors can build on.

What we need to see:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience

• 3+ years of hands-on software engineering.

• Expert-level knowledge in a systems programming language (Go, C, Rust) and a proven understanding of Data Structures, Algorithms, and Distributed Software Architecture

• Strong understanding of container orchestration systems (Kubernetes) and container technologies with hands-on automation experience in continuous integration frameworks like GitLab & ArgoCD.

• Expertise in a scripting language (Bash, Python) and knowledge and experience working with the system internals of Unix/Unix-like kernels such as Linux.

• Understanding of performance, security, and reliability in complex distributed systems.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Background with pub-sub models and message queues

• Experience optimizing for high-throughput network paths, with a working understanding of unary versus streaming and bidirectional protocols across HTTP/2 and gRPC.

• Experience with developing Kubernetes Custom Resources and Operators deployed in Cloud Service Providers

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, NVIDIA is considered one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking individuals in the industry working for us. Due to unprecedented growth, our exclusive engineering teams are expanding rapidly. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a genuine passion for technology, we want to hear from you!

title: Docket Administrator
description:
Docket Administrator
Buchanan Ingersoll & Rooney is a national law firm with a proven reputation for providing progressive, industry-leading legal, business, regulatory and government relations advice to our regional, national and international clients.
We are currently seeking a Docket Administrator to assist in maintaining the Firm’s master litigation calendar and calculating, recording, and delivering deadlines to attorneys and staff pursuant to applicable rules and practices.
This is a fully remote position, though candidates must reside near one of the Firm’s east coast offices ( Pittsburgh, PA, Philadelphia, PA, Harrisburg, PA, Princeton, NJ, Washington, DC, or Miami, FL ) and have the ability to come to the office, for training, equipment retrieval, and other instances when physical presence may be necessary.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities :

• Training and use of CompuLaw’s Vision SQL, Milana, or other docketing software employed by the Firm.

• Receive, review, interpret, and sort incoming communications (correspondence, court orders, emails, briefs, pleadings, etc.) to determine deadlines and events that need to be docketed, and enter those deadlines into the docket control software.

• When necessary, conduct research of court rules for appropriate calendaring. This will include researching websites for state and federal courts, as well as applicable administrative agencies and other judicial and quasi-judicial bodies.

• Maintain up-to-date computer database of calendar entries (data entry).

• Run weekly docket and reminder reports and distribute to attorneys and staff.

• Act as a resource for attorneys and staff regarding court rules as they relate to calendaring and date calculations.

• Communicate with the Docket Manager with regard to docketing issues, attorney and staff issues, the need for court rules not available through docketing software and development of those rules, when necessary.

• Accountability and ownership of deadlines and events and seeing to it that attorneys and staff are reminded of those deadlines and events so that they occur on a timely basis. Keep track of met deadlines and completed events through two-way communications with attorneys, paralegals and practice assistants.

• Maintain database by reviewing and confirming accuracy of all timekeeper and client/matter information.

• Utilize timelines and codes to trigger required limitations for trial, motions, discovery responses, etc. as necessary; review and analyze reports for accuracy based on knowledge of specific code sections and local rules; distribute reports to attorneys and practice assistants as necessary.

• Respond to inquiries by attorneys and staff regarding court rules, deadlines, or any information generated by the docketing system.

• Back up other Docket Administrators, as well as the Docket Manager when needed.

• Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications :

• Thorough understanding of legal terms, pleadings and court structure, including state courts, federal courts, appellate courts, Trademark Trial and Appeal Board, and various other jurisdictions and administrative bodies. Ability to accurately apply court rules and orders to documents and calculate calendar dates.

• Two (2) years’ experience in law office calendaring.

• Ability to use basic office equipment and current versions of Word and Excel.

• Ability to use or learn to use Compulaw or Milana calendar software and ECFx.

• Type accurately for software use and data entry.

• Effective written and oral communication skills.

• Ability to prioritize workload.

• Ability to work at a fast pace while maintaining accuracy.

• Good basic math skills.

• Superior follow-through and attention to detail skills are a must.

• Customer service driven to interact with all levels of staff.

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

• May occasionally be required to work overtime.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead the iOS architectural roadmap, setting the standard for what well-scoped, production-ready iOS changes look like

• Support production incident response for iOS issues and coordinate hotfix releases when needed

Qualifications

• 8+ years of professional iOS engineering experience, with at least 2 years operating at a Staff or equivalent technical leadership level

• Strong grasp of iOS architectural patterns (MVVM, Router/Coordinator, Async/Await) and experience establishing them across a team rather than just applying them personally

• Experience owning CI/CD pipelines for iOS (GitHub Actions, Xcode Cloud, or similar), App Store Connect, TestFlight, and the full release lifecycle

• Hands-on experience with feature flag systems and staged rollout strategies for mobile

• Solid understanding of iOS security: Keychain, certificate pinning, secrets management, App Transport Security, and App Store compliance requirements

• Experience integrating and maintaining push notification platforms (APNs, Firebase Cloud Messaging, or marketing platforms such as SFMC or Braze)

• Proven ability to mentor engineers across experience levels and time zones, raising code quality through standards and review culture rather than by being the sole reviewer

• Strong communication skills; able to clearly articulate technical tradeoffs to both engineering and business stakeholders

Bonus Experience

• Experience with universal links, deep linking, and App Clips

• Familiarity with iOS accessibility APIs and WCAG compliance in native apps

• Experience with Objective-C codebases or mixed Swift/ObjC bridging

• Background in marketplace, auction, or high-frequency transactional mobile applications

• Familiarity with Android development - useful for cross-platform consistency and shared-standards discussions

• Experience with App Store Optimization (ASO) and App Store content strategy

title: Workday Security Administrator
description:
OUR MISSION   

At Redwood Software we unleash human potential. We empower our customers with lights-out automation for their mission-critical business processes.

Redwood Software is the leader in full stack automation for mission-critical business processes. With the first SaaS-based composable automation platform specifically built for ERP, we believe in the transformative power of automation. Our unparalleled solutions empower organizations to orchestrate, manage and monitor their workflows across any application, service or server - in the cloud or on premise - with confidence and control.

CORE VALUES 

One Team. One Redwood

Make Your Own Weather

Obsess over Customer Success

Work the Problem

Be Curious

Own the Outcome

Respect Each Other 

 

YOUR IMPACT 

Redwood is seeking an experienced Workday Security Administrator to join our IT function and support the security architecture of our Workday Financials and HCM tenants. This role is responsible for designing, configuring, maintaining, and auditing Workday security groups, domain/business process policies, and role-based access across the platform. The ideal candidate has deep hands-on Workday security configuration experience and can partner effectively with Finance, HR, and IT stakeholders based in the US while working a schedule aligned to Eastern time zone business hours. This role will be on-site in our Hyderabad office and expected to work 6:30pm - 3:30am IST (8:00am - 5:00pm EST).

• Design, build, and maintain Workday security groups (constrained, unconstrained, role-based, job-based, segment-based) and domain/business process security policies across HCM and Financials, ensuring proper segregation of duties (SoD)

• Own SoD conflict analysis and periodic access recertification, remediating findings in partnership with Finance and HR process owners

• Serve as the primary point of contact for SOX and internal audit requests related to Workday access controls, providing evidence of configuration, approvals, and change history

• Partner with Finance (R2R, P2P, O2C, FP&A) and HR/HCM process owners to translate access and workflow requirements into secure, compliant configurations

• Troubleshoot and resolve security-related tickets - access issues, business process routing errors, permission escalations - within SLA

• Manage security-related change requests through a formal change control process, including impact analysis and testing

• Manage Workday biannual releases, including evaluating new features and impacts, coordinating with internal Workday practitioners to complete testing/implementation of required security configuration changes, and ensuring successful deployment with minimal disruption in access or business process routing.

• Maintain security configuration documentation - group design, business process security matrices, and change logs - as a living audit-ready reference

• Build, test, and maintain Workday integrations, including inbound and outbound interfaces, troubleshooting integration issues, validating data accuracy, and implementing enhancements to support evolving business and system requirements. 

• Administer integration security (ISU accounts, integration system security groups, API access scoping) in coordination with the integrations team

 

YOUR EXPERIENCE

• 5-7+ years of hands-on Workday security administration experience, including direct configuration of security groups and domain/business process policies

• Working knowledge of both Workday HCM and Financials security models (constrained vs. unconstrained groups, segment-based security, org-based security)

• Experience supporting SOX-controlled environments and audit evidence requests

• Experience with Workday EIB, Workday Studio/Core Connectors (for security-adjacent integration work), and report/calculated field security implications

• Strong understanding of segregation of duties principles as applied to finance

• Partner with Sales and Business Development teams to identify customer education needs and develop targeted learning solutions.

• Support practice-development education designed to help customers improve patient experiences and strengthen their businesses.

• Maintain required speaker qualifications and ensure continuing education content remains current and compliant with applicable standards.

The Enterprise Risk Management squad sets the global standards for how Nubank identifies, assesses and manages risk across the enterprise - spanning operational, compliance, technology, conduct and other non‑financial risks, and strongly interfacing with financial risk areas (credit, market, liquidity, capital, treasury).

As part of the ERM Methodology Team, you will sit at the intersection of risk, product and platform: shaping global frameworks, embedding them into data and systems, and scaling them with AI‑enabled workflows so that ERM becomes both a competitive advantage and an enabler of safe growth across products, portfolios and geographies. - Represent ERM methodologies in governance and decision forums.

- Create and refine key risk and performance indicators for ERM programs, enabling better visibility on program effectiveness, maturity and trends.

- Communicate clearly and regularly about ERM methodology initiatives and projects with a wide variety of stakeholders (risk teams in different countries, financial risk functions, internal audit, leadership, product and platform).

What we're looking for:

- Solid experience in Enterprise Risk / Operational Risk / Non‑Financial Risk, with hands‑on ownership of at least one major program or framework (RCSA, control testing, Issue Management, NP&F or equivalent enterprise‑level framework).

- Proven track record as a senior individual contributor leading complex risk initiatives end‑to‑end, from design to rollout, with limited oversight.

- Experience working in multi‑geo or global environments, balancing global standards with local regulatory expectations.

- Strong ability to translate risk methodologies into systems and data (platform requirements, data models, workflow design) in partnership with engineering and product.

- Demonstrated stakeholder management and influence without formal authority, especially across product, risk, compliance and platform/engineering teams.

description: SpAItial is pioneering the next generation of World Models, pushing the boundaries of generative AI, computer vision, and the simulation of reality. Collaborate with research and engineering colleagues to bring successful methods into production systems.

• Senior-level experience creating high-quality UI motion, animation, and/or VFX for mobile F2P games, typically with 5+ years of relevant game industry experience.

• Strong portfolio showing polished reward feedback, celebration moments, transitions, and animated UI systems.

• Strong understanding of animation principles, including timing, easing, anticipation, follow-through, impact, staging, and rhythm.

• Ability to create motion that improves clarity and emotional payoff, not just visual decoration.

• Experience working with game engines, ideally Unity.

• Strong understanding of premium mobile game polish, F2P reward presentation, and player motivation.

• Ability to iterate quickly based on feedback and production needs.

• Understanding of mobile performance considerations for animation, particles, and UI effects.

Nice to Have

• Strong Unity implementation skills, including Animator, Timeline, particle systems, prefabs, UI animation, and optimization.

• Experience with After Effects, Spine, Rive, Lottie, Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, or similar tools.

• Experience creating particle effects, shaders, animated materials, or light/glow treatments.

• Experience supporting LiveOps features, events, offers, bundles, reward screens, and monetization flows.

• Experience creating motion style guides, reusable animation libraries, or UI feedback systems.

• Help bring a globally recognized IP to life with real brand reach and growth potential.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description: Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors. Summary Menlo Security is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join our Threat Protection and ShadowAI team in the UK. This team ensures that users can safely browse the web through Menlo's secure cloud - protecting them from malicious sites (including those built or operated with AI) and securing access to authorised web applications. The services this team builds are core to Menlo's secure enterprise browser for both humans and AI agents, which puts you at the centre of one of the most active problems in enterprise security right now: how organisations gain visibility into and control over unsanctioned AI usage without blocking it entirely. The team applies AI in how it builds as well - code assistants, AI-assisted test generation, and LLM-supported log and incident analysis - so you will be using these tools alongside defending against their misuse. Outcomes & KPIs Key Outcome(s) Owned: Reliable, performant delivery of Threat Protection and ShadowAI services that detect and control risky web and generative AI application usage for Menlo customers.

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

Role: Risk and Control SME

Location: Bangalore

Years of Experience - 9 + years

Key Responsibilities

• Current-state assessment: Review existing end-to-end processes, risks, controls, hand-offs, approvals, manual interventions, exceptions, and pain points.

• Risk identification: Identify operational, regulatory, conduct, fraud, data, technology, third-party, and financial risks affected by process changes.

• Controls assessment: Evaluate whether existing controls are necessary, effective, duplicated, overly manual, or no longer relevant.

• Process re-engineering: Challenge unnecessary approvals, reconciliations, hand-offs, and control steps while ensuring material risks remain appropriately mitigated.

• Future-state control design: Define preventive/detective controls, automated controls, maker-checker arrangements, thresholds, exception handling, access controls, reconciliations, monitoring, and evidence requirements.

• RCSA / risk-control mapping: Map redesigned process steps to risks, controls, control owners, frequencies, evidence, and relevant policies/regulatory obligations.

• Control rationalization: Identify redundant or overlapping controls and opportunities to consolidate or automate them.

• Change-risk assessment: Assess risks introduced by automation, system changes, centralization/offshoring, role changes, straight-through processing, AI, or other transformation initiatives.

• Governance and challenge: Work with process owners, Operations, Technology, Compliance, Operational Risk, Internal Audit and other stakeholders to obtain appropriate challenge and sign-off.

• Implementation assurance: Confirm that controls designed for the future state are implemented, documented, owned and testable before go-live.

title: Sourcing Analyst
description:
Who is Drive Medical …
Drive Medical has become a leading manufacturer of medical products with a strong and consistent track record of growth achieved both organically and through acquisitions. We are proud of our high-quality, diverse product portfolio, channel footprint and global operating scale. Our products are sold into the homecare, long-term care, retail, and e-commerce channels in more than 80 countries around the world.

“Leading the World with Innovative Healthcare Solutions that Enhance Lives”

Summary (Major Purpose of the Role):

The Sourcing Analyst plays a critical role in supporting the organization's procurement and supply chain objectives by identifying, evaluating, and managing supplier opportunities that drive cost savings, quality improvements, and operational efficiency. This position leverages market research, data analysis, and strategic sourcing methodologies to assess supplier capabilities, monitor performance, and develop actionable insights that support business goals. Working collaboratively with cross-functional teams, the Sourcing Analyst supports supplier negotiations, procurement activities, purchase order management, reporting, and analytics while ensuring supplier compliance and service excellence. The ideal candidate is a highly analytical and detail-oriented professional with strong communication skills, a solid understanding of supply chain principles, and the ability to effectively manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Main Activities/Responsibilities:

• Conduct comprehensive market research to identify potential suppliers and evaluate their capabilities, pricing, and service offerings.

• Analyze procurement and sourcing data to identify trends, cost-saving opportunities, and areas for improvement in sourcing strategies.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and implement strategic sourcing initiatives that align with the business objectives.

• Develop, improve, and monitor supplier performance metrics and conduct regular assessments to ensure compliance with contractual obligations.

• Prepare detailed reports and presentations to communicate findings, recommendations, and sourcing strategies to stakeholders.

• Support negotiations with suppliers to achieve favorable terms and conditions while maintaining quality and service standards.

• Procurement activities to include but not limited to PO placement, date management, BO review, weekly and monthly reports and analytics.

Competencies:

• Proficiency in using ERP systems, data visualization and/or other procurement software and tools for data analytics and reporting.

• Strong understanding of supply chain management principles and methodologies.

• Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to identifying and addressing challenges.

• Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities.

• Detail-oriented mindset with a commitment to delivering high-quality work.

• Ability to foster positive relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.

Reporting Relationships and Supervision:

• This position will report directly to the Director of Sourcing and Procurement and will not have direct reports.

Education and Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Business Administration, or a related field.

• 3+ years of experience in sourcing, procurement, or supply chain analysis.

• Strong analytical skills with proficiency in data analysis tools, such as Excel or similar software.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders.

• Preferred experience working in a corporate, or manufacturing, procurement/sourcing environment.

• Preferred familiarity with supplier relationship management and performance evaluation techniques.

• Preferred knowledge of industry trends and best practices in sourcing and procurement.

title: Senior Manager/Associate Director, QA Investigations and Quality Projects
description:
For more than 25 years, Corcept has been singularly focused on the science of cortisol, a powerful hormone that when unregulated, can play a role in a broad range of diseases.

Our commercial portfolio includes treatments for hypercortisolism and oncology, and the company has discovered more than 1,000 proprietary selective cortisol modulators and glucocorticoid receptor antagonists. With advanced clinical trials in patients with hypercortisolism, solid tumors, ALS and liver disease, Corcept is unlocking the power of cortisol modulation to help address some of the most devastating diseases patients face today. 

Corcept is headquartered in Redwood City, California. To learn more, visit www.corcept.com .

The Senior Manager/Associate Director, QA Investigations and Quality Projects is responsible for leading complex quality investigations, managing deviations and CAPA activities, and driving cross-functional quality projects to timely and compliant completion. This role serves as a key Quality Assurance partner to Operations, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality Control, Regulatory Affairs, and external partners to ensure investigation quality, regulatory compliance, effective root cause analysis, and sustainable corrective and preventive actions.

Responsibilities:

• Lead, author, review, and approve quality investigations related to deviations/nonconformances, complaints, temperature excursions, audit findings, and other quality events

• Perform structured root cause analysis using appropriate tools such as 5 Whys, Fishbone, Fault Tree Analysis, risk assessment, and process mapping

• Develop and manage CAPA plans that address root cause, reduce recurrence, and include clear owners, timelines, effectiveness checks, and measurable outcomes

• Serve as project manager for quality initiatives, process improvements, remediation activities, inspection readiness efforts, and cross-functional compliance projects

• Coordinate cross-functional investigation teams, ensuring input from subject matter experts is documented, scientifically sound, and aligned with GMP expectations

• Track investigation, CAPA, and project milestones to ensure timely closure, escalation of risks, and transparent communication to Quality and business leadership

• Evaluate product quality impact and support disposition decisions by assessing risk to patient safety, product quality, regulatory compliance, and supply continuity

• Prepare investigation summaries, executive updates, trend reports, metrics, and presentations for management review, client meetings, audits, and regulatory inspections

• Identify recurring quality issues and recommend process improvements, procedural updates, training actions, or system enhancements to improve quality performance

• Partner with internal and external stakeholders to ensure investigation records, CAPA documentation, and quality project deliverables are accurate, complete, and inspection-ready

Preferred Skills, Qualifications and Technical Proficiencies:

• Strong technical writing and investigation documentation skills

• Sound judgment in quality risk assessment and compliance decision-making

• Excellent project management, prioritization, and follow-through

• Ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority

• Strong communication skills with the ability to present complex issues clearly to leadership and external stakeholders

• High attention to detail, ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement mindset

Preferred Education and Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, chemistry, engineering, or a related scientific discipline; advanced degree preferred

• Minimum of 7 years of experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Systems, Manufacturing Quality, or related GMP-regulated functions within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or CDMO environment

title: Account Director, Enterprise Sales
description:
HONK is a technology-driven roadside assistance platform that connects enterprise customers (insurance carriers, auto clubs, warranty companies, and fleet operators) with a nationwide network of independent service providers. Our mission is to help people and vehicles move forward - quickly, safely, and seamlessly - whenever and wherever it matters most.
Our platform powers one of the largest digital roadside assistance marketplaces in North America, intelligently connecting enterprise customers with a nationwide network of service providers. Through automation, AI, and modern dispatch technology, we're helping the industry move beyond legacy call-center models to deliver faster, more transparent, and more reliable roadside assistance at scale. Backed by private equity and investing aggressively in innovation, we're building the future of roadside assistance.
The Role

As an Account Director, you'll identify strategic opportunities, build executive relationships, navigate complex buying organizations, and lead customers from first conversation through contract execution and successful commercialization.

Unlike many enterprise sales organizations, we believe hunting and long-term account management are different disciplines. Once a customer is successfully commercialized, ownership transitions to our Strategic Account Management team, allowing Account Directors to stay focused on what they do best - creating and winning the next enterprise opportunity.

You Will:

• Create and execute account strategies that open doors, build executive sponsorship, and convert targeted prospects into long-term HONK customers.

• Generate a predictable pipeline through strategic prospecting, executive networking, industry engagement, and partner relationships.

• Establish trusted relationships with executive decision-makers across insurance, automotive, fleet, mobility, and technology organizations.

• Lead complex enterprise sales cycles involving executive leadership, operations, technology, procurement, legal, and finance stakeholders.

• Understand customer business challenges and position HONK ’s platform to deliver measurable business outcomes.

• Develop commercial proposals, executive presentations, business cases, and contract strategies.

• Lead contract negotiations through execution while partnering with internal stakeholders to ensure successful customer commercialization.

• Collaborate closely with Product, Operations, and Strategic Account Management throughout the sales process.

• Maintain accurate pipeline management, forecasting, and CRM reporting.

• Represent HONK professionally at customer meetings, conferences, and industry events.

Qualifications:

• 5+ years of enterprise sales experience selling complex technology or SaaS solutions.

• Proven success acquiring new enterprise customers and consistently exceeding sales targets.

• Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles with Fortune 1000 or large enterprise organizations.

• Executive presence with the ability to build trusted relationships at the C-suite and senior leadership levels.

• Strong business acumen with experience developing commercial strategies, business cases, and executive presentations.

• Excellent negotiation, communication, and relationship management skills.

• Demonstrated ability to thrive in an entrepreneurial environment with a high degree of ownership and autonomy.

• Experience within insurance, automotive, fleet, mobility, marketplace, infrastructure, or enterprise technology organizations is strongly preferred.

At HONK , we're a community of diverse and passionate individuals who believe in the power of remote work and the strength of inclusivity. As a remote-first company, we embrace the boundless possibilities of collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from anywhere in the US.

title: Middle/Senior DevSecOps Engineer (Azure)
description:
For our client, we are looking for a Middle/Senior DevSecOps Engineer (Azure) to join an AI project and strengthen cloud operations, scalability, and automation.
About the Role
This is a hands-on position for an engineer with solid Azure expertise , strong DevOps practices , and a passion for building reliable, secure, and scalable systems. You will focus on infrastructure automation, monitoring, cloud migration, and DR planning , while collaborating with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
Requirements

• 2+ years of experience in Cloud Infrastructure, DevOps, or SRE roles.

• Hands-on experience with Azure Cloud (App Services, AKS, Container Apps).

• Familiarity with AWS or GCP is a plus.

• Strong knowledge of cloud-native technologies, containerized microservices, and architecture patterns .

• Experience migrating from VMs to managed services .

• Knowledge of Disaster Recovery (DR), RTO/RPO .

• Deep understanding of Azure Policies, governance, and networking (TCP/IP, DNS, VPNs, security).

• Experience with SQL Server, PostgreSQL, ElasticSearch, Redis and performance tuning.

• Strong skills in Terraform and Ansible (preferred).

• Scripting with PowerShell, Bash, or Python .

• CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Azure Pipelines .

• Monitoring: Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog with custom metrics and advanced alerting.

• Solid understanding of distributed systems, scalability, and cost optimization .

• English: Upper-Intermediate+ .

Responsibilities

• Monitoring & Observability: Enhance Datadog monitoring, create custom metrics & real-time dashboards.

• Infrastructure Optimization: Migrate VM-hosted workloads to Azure managed services; improve reliability, cost, and performance.

• Automation: Build and maintain IaC with Terraform/Ansible; reduce manual operations.

• Security & Compliance: Enforce Azure policies, governance, and conduct audits.

• Backup & DR: Define RTO/RPO, design strategies, and maintain runbooks.

• CI/CD & Release Management: Build/optimize pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure Pipelines).

• Cost Management: Identify and implement cloud cost-saving opportunities.

• Incident Management: Handle incidents, perform root cause analysis, and document prevention measures.

• Collaboration: Work closely with teams, document infrastructure, and explain complex topics to non-technical stakeholders.

What the Company Offers

• Competitive salary and compensation package.

• Exciting AI startup projects with modern stack.

• Corporate English courses and international client interaction.

• Professional study compensation, certifications, career growth with regular reviews.

• VIP medical insurance or sports coverage.

• Paid vacation (18 days) and sick leave.

• Flexible working hours (start 8:0011:30).

• Unlimited remote work worldwide or offices in Kyiv & Lviv (Starlink & generator).

• Coworking compensation (outside Kyiv & Lviv).

• Corporate lunch, team buildings, soft skills clubs.

• Informal, friendly atmosphere without micromanagement.

• Own charity fund.
